_source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Voxel51/consolidated_receipt_dataset (samples.json index 33, data/000033.png; origin CORD v1 train, https://github.com/clovaai/cord)

_notes: Merchant and date are blurred out in CORD (store info removed), so both are omitted. Currency IDR (Indonesian). Items, qty and totals read from the image and cross-checked against the dataset's menu.nm/cnt/price and subtotal/service/tax/total labels. Low light, small image (576x864). Each item has a 40% line discount (-3,200, -3,600); I keyed totalPrice net of discount (4,800 / 5,400, sum 10,200 = total) with the gross unit price. AMBIGUOUS: a scorer may expect gross 8,000 / 9,000 (CORD menu.price). Category is a snack shop so Groceries or Meals.
